entry.name: jit.gl.skybox
entry.description: The jit.gl.skybox object renders a skybox in a opengl world. A skybox is a cube that remains infinitely far away from the camera, and gives the illusion of distant 3D surroundings. The jit.gl.cubemap object is used to texture the skybox.
